title: Attention Is All You Need
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2017)
relevance_to_qorin: Foundation of decoder-only autoregressive Transformer blocks, self-attention mechanisms, and residual connections.

title: GLU Variants Improve Transformer
relevance_to_qorin: SwiGLU feed-forward network implementation used in ModernGPT-S / QORIN across 16M, 50M, 100M, and 500M models.

title: Root Mean Square Layer Normalization
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2019)
relevance_to_qorin: Pre-norm RMSNorm layer formulation replacing standard LayerNorm to improve throughput and numerical stability.

title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
relevance_to_qorin: Rotary position embedding implementation and linear frequency scaling for 4,096-token context extension.

title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
relevance_to_qorin: Grouped-Query Attention design: 4 KV heads for 12 query heads in 100M (3:1) and 4 KV heads for 24 query heads in 500M (6:1).

title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
relevance_to_qorin: Theoretical basis for the 5,000,000,000 token budget for a 514M parameter model (~9.7 tokens/parameter).

title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
relevance_to_qorin: Fused AdamW optimizer implementation with decoupled weight decay (0.1) across non-1D parameters.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
relevance_to_qorin: Foundation for Dimension B: testing whether external retrieval can compensate for small model capacity limits.

title: The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at Scale
relevance_to_qorin: Primary source for the Quality Web domain (2B tokens / 40% mixture in the QORIN 5B pretraining corpus).

title: SmolLM: Blazing Fast and Remarkably Capable Small Models
relevance_to_qorin: Source for Educational synthetic corpus (Cosmopedia v2, 750M tokens / 15% mixture in 5B corpus).

title: OpenWebMath: An Open Dataset of High-Quality Mathematical Web Text
relevance_to_qorin: Source for Mathematics pretraining domain (375M tokens / 7.5% mixture in 5B corpus).

title: Enhancing Chat Language Models by Scaling High-quality Multi-turn Conversations
relevance_to_qorin: Source for Curated Dialogue pretraining domain (250M tokens / 5% mixture in 5B corpus).
